lead: A hand-painted oil painting on canvas, thick palette-knife strokes and impasto, rich natural colour, epic cinematic scale, dramatic natural light, not a photograph, not a 3D render.
style: Painted full-bleed to all four edges of a 16:9 canvas, no text, no lettering, no signature, no watermark, no frame, no border, no UI

frames.stop: The intro (clouds and changing weather, with the Start button)
frames.prompt: An epic painted sky filled with huge billowing clouds in the middle of changing weather: on the left dark storm clouds with curtains of rain, on the right a break in the clouds with golden sunbeams streaming down onto a sea of cloud, soft mist, the weather in transition between tempest and light, the snowy tip of a colossal mountain peak just emerging through the clouds far in the distance, enormous atmospheric depth, a calm open area in the lower centre of the frame.
